text:
maria: quick heads-up — prod KV/prefix cache hit-rate looks noisy for tail traffic. baseline was ~82% but we're seeing dips to ~62% for requests > 2k tokens after ~25s of inactivity. anyone else?
kevin: saw a spike in SLO errors earlier, i assumed it was backpressure. do you have a trace id?
maria: trace id 3f9b7a (i'll add to the dashboard). spike correlates with many small sessions hitting different prefixes.
ashley: could be cache warmup variance + continuous-batching boundary effects. we tuned batch window last week, maybe interaction. can we repro with microbench?
maria: i'm spinning up a quick run now with a synthetic long-tail mix. will share script.
kevin: if you want me to run a focused KV probe, use this:
```
./kv_probe --model llama-70b --pattern long_tail --prefix-window 64 --p95-duration 60000 --out=kv_run_3f9b7a.log
```
kevin: also instrument with --sample-prefixes=100 to collect eviction snapshots.
infra-bot: scheduled job kv-probe-3f9b7a started on dedicated pool-2 at 2026-03-15T14:12:03Z.
maria: thanks. initial local run shows fragmentation metric jumping from 0.08 -> 0.23 when concurrent prefix churn increases. attaching short log snippet:
```
[2026-03-15 14:12:35] hit_rate: 0.84
[2026-03-15 14:12:50] hit_rate: 0.69
[2026-03-15 14:13:02] eviction_count: 120
[2026-03-15 14:13:02] avg_fragmentation: 0.23
```
jonathan: interesting — fragmentation + eviction spike suggests our eviction policy thresholds might be too aggressive for variable key lengths. maybe switch to LRU-windowed or increase prefix-cache size on ded-poool temporarily?
kevin: i can try running the same trace with `--eviction-policy=windowed-lru --cache-size-mb=8192` and compare. will post numbers.
maria: can you also toggle `--prefix-sampling-rate` to 0.5 and 0.1 to see sensitivity? we want to know if the sampling underestimates hot prefixes and causes thrash.
kevin: yep. running three variants now: baseline, windowed-lru, increased-size. ETA ~20m.
ashley: if windowed-lru helps, we should prototype an adaptive policy that bumps prefix-cache size for models with long-kv sequences. add an RFC?
maria: i can draft short RFC. tagging @kevin for numbers and @ashley for design notes.
jonathan: also add a postmortem-style checklist for oncall: quick command to dump prefix stats + a dashboard panel to surface fragmentation & eviction rate per model.
maria: agreed. after kevin's runs i'll open a tiny PR with the dashboard panels and a runbook snippet.
kevin: update: windowed-lru reduced eviction_count -> 42 and avg_fragmentation -> 0.11 for the long_tail trace. hit_rate recovered to 0.81. pushing logs to s3://redwood-kv-logs/3f9b7a/
maria: amazing — that looks promising. can you attach the perf flame or output a short pprof?
kevin: uploaded pprof link: https://perf.redwood.internal/pprof/3f9b7a. also saved evict snapshots under the run dir.
ashley: great. next steps: 1) small canary with windowed-lru for model group alpha 2) add adaptive sizing RFC 3) dashboard + runbook. i'll own the RFC, maria + kevin will handle canary and dashboard.
maria: thanks everyone. i'll create the canary ticket and RFC stub. leaving this thread for now — ping me if you see regressions. :raised_hands:
